title: Observability: token+KV metrics, tracing integration, dashboards & alert tuning
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Added token- and KV-level metrics + tracing correlation IDs; new Grafana dashboard panels and tuned alert thresholds to reduce noise. No behavior changes to API.
description: Motivation: operators need finer-grained observability into per-request token costs and KV cache behavior to diagnose regressions in latency and cost. This PR adds token-level and KV-cache metrics, ties traces to token buckets for end-to-end latency attribution, introduces new Grafana panels (cost/latency breakdowns by model+route), and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noisy alerts during transient spikes. Changes are scoped to observability and do not alter runtime semantics. Related Linear tasks: ENG-2345 (token-level metrics), ENG-2390 (dashboard and alert tuning). Related incident: SUP-1021 informed some threshold decisions.

review_conversation: Diego Rivera (reviewer): Overall looks good; two asks - add a low-cardinality 'route' tag to token metrics and lower the histogram bucket resolution for cost to reduce cardinality. Also ensure the new dashboard respects per-tenant RBAC.

Ava Chen (author): Thanks - added 'route' label to token_* metrics and reduced cost histogram buckets from 50 to 12 in the latest commit. Dashboard JSON updated to use org/role access filters. See commit 8a7d2f4 and deploy change in charts/observability/values.yaml.
Malika Gupta (reviewer): Confirmed tracing attributes show up in kibana/span view. One nit: include the model family in the dashboard panel title.
Ava Chen (author): Added model family to panel titles and included example dashboard variable for model_family. Also added a dashboard note explaining sampling when high request volumes occur.

Ethan Park (reviewer): unit tests look good. CI flaky test 'metrics_test.go:TestHistogramBuckets' failed once on first run but passed after the buckets change. Recommend we watch the p95 alert for a week before tightening further.
Ava Chen (author): Agreed - set alert severity to 'warning' for 7 days and added runbook to escalate to on-call SRE if repeated.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for metrics labels and histogram buckets. Integration smoke validates Prometheus metrics scrape and trace attribute propagation. Observability CI passed in staging cluster (token metrics visible for synthetic workload).
deployment_steps: 1) Deploy metrics registration in canary runtime pool; 2) Deploy new prometheus rules; 3) Import Grafana dashboard via CI job; 4) Monitor p95 token_latency and kv_eviction_rate for 72h; 5) Move alert severity from warning to critical after validated stability.
merge_summary: Merged via squash on 2025-10-08. Summary: token-level and KV metrics added, tracing correlation for tokens implemented, Grafana dashboard and alerts added and tuned. No API breaking changes. Monitoring/alerts set to warning for 7 days as a safety buffer.
post_merge_actions:
- Monitor dashboard panels for unexpected cardinality/ingest costs
- Watch Prometheus TSDB for increased series count; revert bucket granularity if needed
- Follow up: ENG-2410 to add tenant-level sampling policy if series growth is high
notes: This PR was coordinated with SRE on alert escalation paths and with the Security team to confirm no sensitive data is emitted in traces. Dashboard JSON sanitized to avoid PII.
